Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with chest pain followed by loss of consciousness

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 43-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their third dose of DemoGluca.
Treatment started on 2026-08-02.
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed chest pain followed by loss of consciousness.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
P. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter771@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
